pain_point: No warehouse stock available in right size
headline_pain: Zero Stock. Zero Options. Until Now.
primary_text: "There's literally nothing available to buy in the size range we need in the west." If you've been searching, you already know the market is bone dry. Anything decent gets sold off-market or to developers before you even see it. Time's running out to keep waiting. New off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina are being released specifically for owner-occupiers who need the right-sized space. 20km from Melbourne CBD. Direct Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel access. These won't sit on the market long. Secure yours before this stock disappears too.
description: New warehouse stock released specifically for small business owner-occupiers
